_comment: User-facing text for mc-course-intake/mc-course-intake.gs. Edit here; changes are live within ~5 minutes (script cache TTL). Use {{placeholder}} syntax for dynamic values.
approved_body:
Dear {{instructor_name}},

Your MorphoCloud course "{{course_name}}" has been approved.

STEP 1 - Accept your GitHub invitation(s)
Before you can access your course repository ({{repo_name}}), accept your pending GitHub invitation(s):
  - MorphoCloud organization: https://github.com/settings/organizations
  - Repository: {{repo_url}}/invitations (or use the invitation link GitHub emailed you)

What happens next
We are finishing the setup of your course environment (compute allocation and the course runner). You will receive a second email - "Your course is ready" - once it is provisioned, with your student roster and how to enroll students and launch instances. Please wait for that email before creating any instances.

Questions? Contact {{contact_email}}

-- The MorphoCloud Team

student_invited_subject: You're enrolled in {{course_name}} on MorphoCloud - accept your invitation
student_invited_body:
Hi,

You have been enrolled in the MorphoCloud course "{{course_name}}".

ACTION REQUIRED - accept your GitHub invitation (it expires in 7 days):
  1. Go to https://github.com/settings/organizations
  2. Accept the pending invitation from MorphoCloud.

Once you have accepted, request your cloud instance:
  1. Open the course repository: {{repo_url}}
  2. Open a new Instance Request issue and follow the prompts.
  3. Post /create as a comment to launch your instance. You will receive an email with your connection details when it is ready.

Questions? Contact your instructor or {{contact_email}}.

-- The MorphoCloud Team

course_ready_body:
Dear {{instructor_name}},

Your MorphoCloud course "{{course_name}}" is ready. (If you haven't accepted your own GitHub invitation yet: https://github.com/settings/organizations)

Enrolling each student has TWO parts — you must do BOTH:
  1. Add them to your ROSTER (Google Sheet) — supplies their email.
  2. Add them to students.txt (course repo) — invites them to GitHub and gives them access.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PART 1 — YOUR STUDENT ROSTER  (Google Sheet, shared with {{roster_google_account}})
  {{roster_url}}
  - Column A is github_handle, Column B is email. Don't rename, move, or delete the header row — the system looks these columns up by name, and changing them will stop instance emails from reaching your students.
  - Add your own row first so you can test /create right away.
The roster only supplies emails; it does not grant access — that's Part 2.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PART 2 — ENROLL YOUR STUDENTS TO YOUR COURSE REPO  (GitHub)
Paste the github_handle values (one per line) into students.txt in your course repository, then commit and push:
  {{repo_url}}

This is what invites your students. Each student is sent a GitHub invitation they must accept within 7 days (it expires after that); until they accept, they have no access and can't create an instance.

⚠ If you skip Part 2, your students are never invited and never get access. Enrollment is ongoing, not one-time — you can add students at any point, as long as you add each one to BOTH the roster (Google Sheet) and students.txt (GitHub repo).

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LAUNCHING INSTANCES
After accepting their invitation, a student opens an Instance Request issue and posts /create. They get an email with connection details when the instance is ready.

COURSES WITH MORE THAN 9 PARTICIPANTS
JetStream2 enforces a default per-allocation quota of 25 instances and 10 volumes. If your total headcount (students + instructors) exceeds 9, request a quota increase before the course starts — to headcount + 2, for BOTH instances and volumes — via an ACCESS support ticket. Details + boilerplate:
  https://github.com/MorphoCloud/docs/blob/main/instructor/post-repo.md#important-for-courses-with-more-than-9-students

A NOTE ABOUT EMAILS
The emails that matter come from no-reply@morphocloud.org (credentials, enrollment, action items) — remind students to check spam. GitHub's own notifications can be ignored.

DOCUMENTATION
  Post-approval setup guide:
  https://github.com/MorphoCloud/docs/blob/main/instructor/post-repo.md
  Instructor overview (course day-1 actions):
  https://github.com/MorphoCloud/docs/blob/main/instructor/README.md#course-day-1-actions

Questions? Contact {{contact_email}}

Note: some email systems (e.g., Outlook Safe Links) may rewrite the links above into long, unusual-looking URLs. They still work — open them as normal.

-- The MorphoCloud Team
